slides.headline: Why giving "One Month Free" destroys your building's value.
slides.body: It's the most common reaction to a softening market. It's also the most expensive.

slides.headline: The Panic Move.
slides.body: Vacancy ticks up 2%. Your leasing manager panics, looks at the competitor across the street, and copies their special.

slides.headline: The Concession Trap.
slides.body: You give away $2,500 to 30 new tenants this year. But half of them were ready to sign for a $500 deposit reduction.

slides.headline: The Brutal Math.
slides.body: $37,500 in NOI completely wasted. At a 5% Cap Rate, that single panic move erased $750,000 from your valuation.

slides.headline: Stop guessing.
slides.body: Use real-time market intelligence. Know exactly what concessions are needed to close—and not a single dollar more.
